source_text: Abraham seniorem servum iurat: non uxorem de Chananaeis filio, sed de cognatione. Cameli onusti; oratio ad puteum.
pass_a_gloss: Abraham elder servant swears: not wife from Canaanites for-son, but from kinship. Camels laden; prayer at well.
pass_b_english: [[Abraham binds the elder servant by oath >> Bible:Genesis 24:2-4]]: not a wife from the Canaanites for his son, but from his kin. Camels are laden; prayer is made at the well.
